name: sepsis_sbml
description: The BioGears sepsis core as its SBML/Antimony extraction (Sauro), run via Tellurium / roadrunner. Emits the 9 shared comparison observables (SBP, DBP, MAP, HR, CO, SVR, blood volume, tissue integrity, blood pathogen). Infection is seeded from `severity` at t = infection_start_s. Healthy at severity 0.

severity.description: 0 none / 1 mild / 2 moderate / 3 severe (seeds tissue pathogen)

infection_start_s.description: Infection start time in seconds (applied only when severity > 0)

tellurium.doc:
Bridge Process wrapping a Tellurium / libroadrunner SBML simulation.

Loads an SBML or Antimony model into a RoadRunner instance and advances
it in chunks of `interval` on each update() call. Returns absolute
species concentrations, reaction rates, parameter values, and the
current time as overwrite values.

SPECIES PORT (important):
  * DEFAULT (``bulk_species=True``): the ``species`` port is a numpy
    ``array[(n,),float]`` ordered by ``getFloatingSpeciesIds`` and moved via
    roadrunner's bulk C API — ~2x faster per update() and bit-identical.
    Wire it to an Array-shaped store, not a dict.
  * COUPLED multi-process composites (two+ processes sharing one species
    store, operator-split): also set ``coupled_species=True`` — the species
    output becomes an ADDITIVE array so the arms' deltas SUM under reconcile
    instead of clobbering, and only the settable subset is written back.
  * LEGACY (``bulk_species=False``): the old per-species ``map[float]`` port;
    slower, kept only for back-compat with dict-shaped species stores.

Config:
    model: Antimony or SBML source string.
    model_format: 'antimony' (default) or 'sbml'.
    model_file: Optional path to a local .ant/.txt/.xml file
        (takes precedence over `model`).
    integrator: 'cvode' (deterministic) or 'gillespie' (stochastic).
    absolute_tolerance: CVODE absolute tolerance.
    relative_tolerance: CVODE relative tolerance.
    seed: Random seed for stochastic integrators (None = unset).
    species_overrides: Mapping of {species_id: initial_value}
        applied after model load.
    parameter_overrides: Mapping of {parameter_id: value}
        applied after model load. These are initial values only: a
        value on the ``parameters_in`` input port overrides them from
        the first update() that carries it.
    reset_on_init: If True, call reset() after applying overrides
        (default True).

_contract.summary: Advances a user-authored Antimony/SBML kinetic model one coupling interval by integrating its ODE system dX/dt = f(X, p; t) with libroadrunner (CVODE).

inputs.species: optional incoming floating-species state pushed into roadrunner before the step (numpy array ordered by getFloatingSpeciesIds when bulk_species=True, else a {species_id: value} map); in coupled_species mode this is the shared-store baseline the arm starts from
inputs.parameters_in: {parameter_id: value} global parameter values set in roadrunner before each step; they override parameter_overrides and persist until changed. Ids must be global parameters not defined by an assignment rule; a writer should declare overwrite[...] so its values replace, not add to, the store

outputs.species: post-step floating-species state (overwrite; an ADDITIVE delta in coupled_species mode)
outputs.rates: {reaction_id: rate} reaction velocities v at the new state (getReactionRates)
outputs.time: roadrunner current time after the step

config.model_file: optional path to a local .ant/.txt/.xml model (takes precedence over model)
config.seed: random seed for stochastic integrators (-1 = unset)
config.parameter_overrides: {parameter_id: value} applied after model load (initial values; parameters_in overrides them)
config.bulk_species: species port as a numpy Array via roadrunner's bulk C API (default True) vs a legacy map[float]
config.coupled_species: operator-split mode: additive species deltas that SUM under multi-process reconcile
config.conserved_moiety_analysis: let roadrunner slave moiety-dependent species to conservation laws

math: \frac{dX}{dt} = f(X,\, p;\, t) = S\, v(X,\, p)
v = v(X,\, p) \quad\text{(reaction-rate vector returned on the } \texttt{rates} \text{ port)}

symbols.X: floating-species state vector (concentrations by default, or amounts), ordered by getFloatingSpeciesIds
symbols.p: global kinetic parameters of the model
symbols.\\Delta t: coupling interval advanced per update() call
symbols.f: ODE right-hand side assembled by libroadrunner from the model's reactions
symbols.X^{(i)}: the i-th coupled arm's post-step state in operator-split (coupled_species) mode

assumptions: Deterministic CVODE (BDF) integration by default; stiffness is handled internally by CVODE. Set integrator='gillespie' for stochastic SSA.
The reaction network is user-authored (Antimony/SBML) and loaded at build time, so this contract specifies the integration and port semantics, not any specific reaction equations.
Species are reported as concentrations unless the model yields amounts; the state vector is ordered by getFloatingSpeciesIds.
update() is stateful across intervals (roadrunner carries state between calls); the Step variants reset each firing instead.
coupled_species assumes a Lie/Jacobi operator split across processes sharing one species store; each arm emits its own delta and the deltas sum under reconcile.
references: Somogyi et al. (2015) libRoadRunner: a high performance SBML simulation and analysis library.
Hindmarsh et al. (2005) SUNDIALS: CVODE stiff/non-stiff ODE integration.

_antimony.text:
// =====================================================================
// BioGears sepsis core in Antimony
//
// Translated from the BioGears physiology engine (Apache License 2.0,
// github.com/BioGearsEngine/core): cardiovascular circuit, tissue fluid
// exchange with albumin transport, baroreflex, and the Acute Inflammatory
// Response model (McDaniel et al. 2019, Front Physiol 10:1321).
// Patient: BioGears StandardMale (77.1 kg, HR 72, BP 114/73.5).
//
// Units: time s, pressure mmHg, volume mL, flow mL/s, albumin g.
// Inflammation equations are written per hour in BioGears; here each
// derivative is divided by 3600 and multiplied by infScale (default 1).
//
// Circuit conventions (as in the BioGears circuit solver):
//  - each compliant node carries charge q = C*P, so P = q/C; when the
//    baroreflex rescales C, q is conserved and P moves (venous pooling)
//  - node blood volume = q + U, with U the unstressed volume fixed at setup
//  - valves are ideal diodes in series with the path resistance
//
// Differences from BioGears:
//  - CV-only circuit: no detailed renal (no urine) or cerebral circuits;
//    kidneys and brain are the simple windkessels BioGears uses when those
//    modules are off
//  - SI, LI and splanchnic merged into one gut node (BioGears ties them
//    with zero-resistance pressure sources); pulmonary veins merged with
//    the left atrium (joined by 2e-6 mmHg s/mL in BioGears)
//  - no intracellular water shift, respiration, gas exchange, energy,
//    temperature or lactate; chemoreceptor and lung-stretch afferents fixed
//  - single well-mixed plasma albumin pool
//  - stabilisation tuned with BioGears' TuneCircuit scale factors here, so
//    resistances and compliances differ slightly from a BioGears run
//  - baroreceptor set-point adaptation omitted (BioGears disables it
//    during infection); NO has no direct haemodynamic effect (as in the
//    current BioGears code)
//  - BioGears' tissue-pathogen equation is kept as coded, with (1 - PT)
//    where (1 - PT/uP) was probably intended
// Start an infection with severity = 1, 2 or 3 and infectionStart > 0.
// =====================================================================

function hillA(x, n, h)
  x^h/(x^h + n^h)
end

function hillI(x, n, h)
  1/(1 + (x/n)^h)
end

model biogears_sepsis

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Patient and setup targets (BioGears SetupPatient, SetupCardiovascular)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  BV = 5517.73               // baseline blood volume, 65.6*weight^1.02
  SBP0 = 114.0; DBP0 = 73.5; HR0 = 72.0
  CO0 = 97.2             // target cardiac output (81 mL x 72/min)
  HRmax = 177.2; HRmin = 0.001
  srm = 0.849                  // systemicResistanceModifier
  lacm = 0.4333                // largeArteriesComplianceModifier
  // stabilisation scales (BioGears TuneCircuit equivalents; set by tuning here)
  sR = 1; sC = 1; sRao = 1; sCao = 1; sRrh = 1; sCvc = 1

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Vascular resistances (mmHg s/mL), computed from target pressures and
  // flows exactly as in SetupCardiovascular
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  P_VC0 = 3.7962; P_LV0 = 121.6; P_RH0 = 19.0004
  R_ao := sRao*(P_LV0 - SBP0)/CO0
  R_rh := sRrh*(4.8165 - P_VC0)/CO0   // vena cava to right atrium
  R_ra = 5.94e-5; R_la = 8.9e-5   // atrium to ventricle (through valve)
  R_Brain_a0 := sR*srm*0.94*(SBP0 - 9.12)/11.664
  R_Brain_v0 := sR*srm*(9.12 - P_VC0)/11.664
  R_Bone_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/4.86
  R_Bone_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - P_VC0)/4.86
  R_Fat_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/4.86
  R_Fat_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - P_VC0)/4.86
  R_LArm_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/0.703728
  R_LArm_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - P_VC0)/0.703728
  R_RArm_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/0.703728
  R_RArm_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - P_VC0)/0.703728
  R_LKidney_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/4.7628
  R_LKidney_v0 := sR*(37.62 - P_VC0)/4.7628
  R_RKidney_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/4.7628
  R_RKidney_v0 := sR*(37.62 - P_VC0)/4.7628
  R_LLeg_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/1.05559
  R_LLeg_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - P_VC0)/1.05559
  R_RLeg_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/1.05559
  R_RLeg_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - P_VC0)/1.05559
  R_Muscle_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/16.524
  R_Muscle_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - P_VC0)/16.524
  R_Myocard_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/3.888
  R_Myocard_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - P_VC0)/3.888
  R_Skin_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 9.4962)/6.5124
  R_Skin_v0 := sR*srm*(9.4962 - P_VC0)/6.5124
  R_Spleen_a0 := sR*srm*1.0*(SBP0 - 37.62)/2.916
  R_Spleen_v0 := sR*srm*(37.62 - 28.5)/2.916
  R_Gut_a0 := sR*srm/(9.72/(SBP0 - 37.62) + 3.888/(SBP0 - 37.62) + 2.50776/(SBP0 - 37.62))   // SI, LI, splanchnic in parallel
  R_Gut_v0 := sR*srm/(9.72/(37.62 - 28.5) + 3.888/(37.62 - 28.5) + 2.50776/(37.62 - 28.5))
  R_Liver_a0 := sR*srm*(SBP0 - 28.5)/7.29
  R_Liver_v0 := sR*srm*(28.5 - P_VC0)/26.3218
  R_PV := sR*srm*0.001       // portal vein path
  R_RPA = (19.0004 - 15.1996)/45.7545   // BioGears uses the left-lung value for both sides
  R_RPCap = (15.1996 - 7.41)/50.5707
  R_RPVein = (7.41 - 4.38444)/50.5707
  R_RShunt = (15.1996 - 7.41)/0.8748
  R_LPA = (19.0004 - 15.1996)/45.7545   // BioGears uses the left-lung value for both sides
  R_LPCap = (15.1996 - 7.41)/45.7545
  R_LPVein = (7.41 - 4.38444)/45.7545
  R_LShunt = (15.1996 - 7.41)/0.8748

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Compliances (mL/mmHg) = baseline volume / target pressure; volume
  // modifiers then raise baseline volumes, giving unstressed volumes U
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  C_LA = 44.9278 + 40.6489 + 1.77356   // pulmonary veins + left atrium
  U_LA = 255.525 - C_LA*4.9
  C_Ao0 := sCao*lacm*275.887/114
  U_Ao = 1.1891*275.887 - C_Ao0*114
  C_Brain0 := sC*66.2128/9.12
  U_Brain = 1.03634*66.2128 - C_Brain0*9.12
  C_Bone0 := sC*386.241/37.62
  U_Bone = 1.15868*386.241 - C_Bone0*37.62
  C_Fat0 := sC*275.887/37.62
  U_Fat = 1.15973*275.887 - C_Fat0*37.62
  C_LArm0 := sC*55.1773/37.62
  U_LArm = 1.15974*55.1773 - C_LArm0*37.62
  C_RArm0 := sC*55.1773/37.62
  U_RArm = 1.15974*55.1773 - C_RArm0*37.62
  C_LKidney0 := sC*52.4185/37.62
  U_LKidney = 0.703967*52.4185 - C_LKidney0*37.62
  C_RKidney0 := sC*52.4185/37.62
  U_RKidney = 0.703967*52.4185 - C_RKidney0*37.62
  C_LLeg0 := sC*83.3178/37.62
  U_LLeg = 1.15974*83.3178 - C_LLeg0*37.62
  C_RLeg0 := sC*83.3178/37.62
  U_RLeg = 1.15974*83.3178 - C_RLeg0*37.62
  C_Muscle0 := sC*772.483/37.62
  U_Muscle = 1.15974*772.483 - C_Muscle0*37.62
  C_Myocard0 := sC*38.6241/37.62
  U_Myocard = 1.15973*38.6241 - C_Myocard0*37.62
  C_Skin0 := sC*176.568/9.4962
  U_Skin = 1.04326*176.568 - C_Skin0*9.4962
  C_Spleen0 := sC*77.2483/37.62
  U_Spleen = 1.15942*77.2483 - C_Spleen0*37.62
  C_Gut0 := sC*378.517/37.62
  U_Gut = 1.15913*378.517 - C_Gut0*37.62
  C_Liver0 := sC*584.88/28.5
  U_Liver = 1.14804*584.88 - C_Liver0*28.5
  C_VC0 := sCvc*1362.88/3.7962
  U_VC = 0.759308*1362.88 - C_VC0*3.7962
  C_RA0 := 1*8.69043/2.9
  U_RA = 1*8.69043 - C_RA0*2.9
  C_RPA0 := 1*98.4916/15.1996
  U_RPA = 0.896934*98.4916 - C_RPA0*15.1996
  C_RPC0 := 1*66.6266/7.41
  U_RPC = 0.782749*66.6266 - C_RPC0*7.41
  C_LPA0 := 1*89.1114/15.1996
  U_LPA = 0.986127*89.1114 - C_LPA0*15.1996
  C_LPC0 := 1*60.2812/7.41
  U_LPC = 0.841728*60.2812 - C_LPC0*7.41
  EmaxL0 = 2.49; EminL = 0.049; EmaxR0 = 1.08; EminR = 0.0243
  U_LV = 10.6216; U_RV = 10.6216

  // live compliances: baroreflex scales systemic organ compliances
  C_Ao := C_Ao0
  C_Brain := C_Brain0
  C_Bone := C_Bone0*cScale
  C_Fat := C_Fat0*cScale
  C_LArm := C_LArm0*cScale
  C_RArm := C_RArm0*cScale
  C_LKidney := C_LKidney0*cScale
  C_RKidney := C_RKidney0*cScale
  C_LLeg := C_LLeg0*cScale
  C_RLeg := C_RLeg0*cScale
  C_Muscle := C_Muscle0*cScale
  C_Myocard := C_Myocard0*cScale
  C_Skin := C_Skin0*cScale
  C_Spleen := C_Spleen0*cScale
  C_Gut := C_Gut0*cScale
  C_Liver := C_Liver0*cScale
  C_VC := C_VC0
  C_RA := C_RA0
  C_RPA := C_RPA0
  C_RPC := C_RPC0
  C_LPA := C_LPA0
  C_LPC := C_LPC0

  // pressures
  P_Ao := q_Ao/C_Ao
  P_Brain := q_Brain/C_Brain
  P_Bone := q_Bone/C_Bone
  P_Fat := q_Fat/C_Fat
  P_LArm := q_LArm/C_LArm
  P_RArm := q_RArm/C_RArm
  P_LKidney := q_LKidney/C_LKidney
  P_RKidney := q_RKidney/C_RKidney
  P_LLeg := q_LLeg/C_LLeg
  P_RLeg := q_RLeg/C_RLeg
  P_Muscle := q_Muscle/C_Muscle
  P_Myocard := q_Myocard/C_Myocard
  P_Skin := q_Skin/C_Skin
  P_Spleen := q_Spleen/C_Spleen
  P_Gut := q_Gut/C_Gut
  P_Liver := q_Liver/C_Liver
  P_VC := q_VC/C_VC
  P_RA := q_RA/C_RA
  P_RPA := q_RPA/C_RPA
  P_RPC := q_RPC/C_RPC
  P_LPA := q_LPA/C_LPA
  P_LPC := q_LPC/C_LPC
  P_LA := q_LA/C_LA
  P_LV := EL*q_LV
  P_RV := ER*q_RV

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Heart driver: double-Hill elastance (Stergiopulos 1996), period and
  // Emax fixed at the start of each beat as in BeginCardiacCycle
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  tc' = 1
  tn := tc/Tcyc
  eshape := ((tn/0.303)^1.32/(1 + (tn/0.303)^1.32))*(1/(1 + (tn/0.508)^21.9))/0.598
  EL := (EmaxL - EminL)*eshape + EminL
  ER := (EmaxR - EminR)*eshape + EminR
  HRdrive := max(HRmin, min(HRmax, HR0*hrScale))
  E_beat: at (tc >= Tcyc): tc = 0, Tcyc = 60/HRdrive, EmaxL = EmaxL0*eScale, EmaxR = EmaxR0*eScale, SBP = PmaxAo, DBP = PminAo, MAP = PintAo/Tcyc, CVP = PintVC/Tcyc, SV = beatSV, HR = 60/Tcyc, PmaxAo = P_Ao, PminAo = P_Ao, PintAo = 0, PintVC = 0, beatSV = 0
  // per-beat measurements
  PmaxAo' = 200*max(0, P_Ao - PmaxAo)
  PminAo' = -200*max(0, PminAo - P_Ao)
  PintAo' = P_Ao
  PintVC' = P_VC
  beatSV' = Q_aov
  COmeas := SV*HR/1000          // L/min

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Flows (mL/s)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  Q_aov := max(0, P_LV - P_Ao)/R_ao           // aortic valve
  Q_mit := max(0, P_LA - P_LV)/R_la           // mitral valve
  Q_tri := max(0, P_RA - P_RV)/R_ra           // tricuspid valve
  Q_rh  := (P_VC - P_RA)/R_rh
  pulOpen := piecewise(1, P_RV > (P_RPA + P_LPA)/2, 0)   // pulmonic valve
  Q_RPA := pulOpen*(P_RV - P_RPA)/R_RPA
  Q_LPA := pulOpen*(P_RV - P_LPA)/R_LPA
  Q_RPCap := (P_RPA - P_RPC)/R_RPCap
  Q_RShunt := (P_RPA - P_LA)/R_RShunt
  Q_RPVein := (P_RPC - P_LA)/R_RPVein
  Q_LPCap := (P_LPA - P_LPC)/R_LPCap
  Q_LShunt := (P_LPA - P_LA)/R_LShunt
  Q_LPVein := (P_LPC - P_LA)/R_LPVein
  R_Brain_a := R_Brain_a0
  R_Brain_v := R_Brain_v0
  R_Bone_a := max(0.1, R_Bone_a0*rsExt)
  R_Bone_v := max(0.1, R_Bone_v0*rsExt)
  R_Fat_a := max(0.1, R_Fat_a0*rsExt)
  R_Fat_v := max(0.1, R_Fat_v0*rsExt)
  R_LArm_a := max(0.1, R_LArm_a0*rsExt)
  R_LArm_v := max(0.1, R_LArm_v0*rsExt)
  R_RArm_a := max(0.1, R_RArm_a0*rsExt)
  R_RArm_v := max(0.1, R_RArm_v0*rsExt)
  R_LKidney_a := max(0.1, R_LKidney_a0*rsExt)
  R_LKidney_v := max(0.1, R_LKidney_v0*rsExt)
  R_RKidney_a := max(0.1, R_RKidney_a0*rsExt)
  R_RKidney_v := max(0.1, R_RKidney_v0*rsExt)
  R_LLeg_a := max(0.1, R_LLeg_a0*rsExt)
  R_LLeg_v := max(0.1, R_LLeg_v0*rsExt)
  R_RLeg_a := max(0.1, R_RLeg_a0*rsExt)
  R_RLeg_v := max(0.1, R_RLeg_v0*rsExt)
  R_Muscle_a := max(0.1, R_Muscle_a0*rsMus)
  R_Muscle_v := max(0.1, R_Muscle_v0*rsMus)
  R_Myocard_a := R_Myocard_a0
  R_Myocard_v := R_Myocard_v0
  R_Skin_a := max(0.1, R_Skin_a0*rsExt)
  R_Skin_v := max(0.1, R_Skin_v0*rsExt)
  R_Spleen_a := max(0.1, R_Spleen_a0*rsSpl)
  R_Spleen_v := max(0.1, R_Spleen_v0*rsSpl)
  R_Gut_a := max(0.1, R_Gut_a0*rsSpl)
  R_Gut_v := max(0.1, R_Gut_v0*rsSpl)
  R_Liver_a := max(0.1, R_Liver_a0*rsSpl)
  R_Liver_v := max(0.1, R_Liver_v0*rsSpl)
  R_PVs := R_PV*rsSpl
  // portal vein: no compliance, pressure from Kirchhoff's current law
  P_portal := (P_Gut/R_Gut_v + P_Spleen/R_Spleen_v + P_Liver/R_PVs)/(1/R_Gut_v + 1/R_Spleen_v + 1/R_PVs)
  Qa_Brain := (P_Ao - P_Brain)/R_Brain_a
  Qa_Bone := (P_Ao - P_Bone)/R_Bone_a
  Qa_Fat := (P_Ao - P_Fat)/R_Fat_a
  Qa_LArm := (P_Ao - P_LArm)/R_LArm_a
  Qa_RArm := (P_Ao - P_RArm)/R_RArm_a
  Qa_LKidney := (P_Ao - P_LKidney)/R_LKidney_a
  Qa_RKidney := (P_Ao - P_RKidney)/R_RKidney_a
  Qa_LLeg := (P_Ao - P_LLeg)/R_LLeg_a
  Qa_RLeg := (P_Ao - P_RLeg)/R_RLeg_a
  Qa_Muscle := (P_Ao - P_Muscle)/R_Muscle_a
  Qa_Myocard := (P_Ao - P_Myocard)/R_Myocard_a
  Qa_Skin := (P_Ao - P_Skin)/R_Skin_a
  Qa_Spleen := (P_Ao - P_Spleen)/R_Spleen_a
  Qa_Gut := (P_Ao - P_Gut)/R_Gut_a

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).
